description: Adds Devin CLI memory support, task/session safety fixes, and the Pennix beta package identity.
changelog:
**Enhancements:**
- `trellis mem` can read Cognition Devin CLI sessions from `~/.local/share/devin/cli/sessions.db` (`--platform devin`).
- Publishes the Trellis CLI and Core packages under the `@pennixrv` scope.

**Bug fixes:**
- SQLite mem readers load main-file pages on demand instead of the whole database.
- Pi headless subagents forward ask-policy prompts to the parent session.
- Active-task lookup no longer binds another session's task when the current session id is missing.
- `task.py archive` restores child `parent` links if it stops after unlinking some children.
- Channel startup records its event barrier before spawning the runtime and cleans up correctly on startup failures.
notes: No file migration required. Existing projects can upgrade normally.
